name: Mr. Bud
portrait_alt: A cold golden beer in a tall glass on a restaurant table
context: The user introduced Mr. Bud as a fictional character and supplied a close-up photo of a cold golden beer in a tall restaurant glass. First-party Budweiser pages reviewed 2026-08-30 say Budweiser was developed in St. Louis in 1876 as a lighter, thirst-quenching lager; the current product is described as a medium-bodied, crisp American-style lager brewed with barley malt, rice, and hops. The Budweiser Clydesdales debuted in 1933. Sources: https://us.budweiser.com/, https://us.budweiser.com/budweiser, https://us.budweiser.com/history/, and https://us.budweiser.com/About-Us/
lede: The Gay Guy of the Week is a completely serious investigation into Mr. Bud’s golden-hour complexion, frosted-glass tailoring, and a foam crown with its own publicist.
verdict: After dozens of seconds of rigorous research, the panel has reached a verdict: Mr. Bud has been crisp since 1876 and still refuses to enter a room without a full Clydesdale escort.
quote: “He did not get poured; he made a head-first entrance and requested the Clydesdales.”
